title: Another Fold for Amy’s Map
synopsis: Six friends revisit Market Street; Kim returns her library book, and Amy extends her yellow map with a fold-out panel for the bus journey.
continuity_state: Before: All six friends know the green bus and Market Street through different trips. Kim still has the borrowed The Loud Blue Sock at home. Amy’s physical yellow map still ends by Far Meadow; Sue’s bakery has the new pretend pocket clock. After: All six children visit Market Street with their grown-ups. Kim and her grown-up return The Loud Blue Sock to the public library. Each child remembers a real market landmark. At home Grandma May helps Amy attach a new yellow fold-out flap to the west edge of her physical map, distinguishing the green bus line on the paved road from the walkable path over Bell Hill. Market Street’s bakery, shop clock, library, pigeon bench and flower stall become real map marks. The map goes beside Amy’s bed; the three Story House collections and repaired door, garden, lantern, pouch, hat, boots, and Sue’s bakery stay as before. There is no pending event.
